main_text.p:
Obliuioso flumine mergere
Conatur, immistisque Auerni
Perpetua sepelire nocte.

Sed laude dignum, & quem meritis sonant
Clarum Camœnæ: Pieridum & fauor
Extollit almus, ridet ille
Iura stygis truculenta furuæ:

Sæuósque morsus temporis inuidi,
Mortésque vitat, carminis alite
Si fama subuectum sonoro
Per memores canat vsque fastos.

Quid? sola cunctis Calliope potest
Monstrare terris te celebrem: tua
Si facta venturo disertis
Carminibus memorârit ævo.

Vt (fastuosis quum Lotharingicæ
Te Gentis olim seditionibus
Rex iussit expertus fidelem
Helueticas properare ad vrbes)

Velox Geneuam tramite deuio
Promptam aduolasti iungere dexteras,
Regique prouisum paratam
Auxilium dare fœderato.

Atque hinc feraces Helueticæ petens
Agros propinquæ, Marte ferocia
Mox corda Gentis compulisti
Tendere opem sociásque vires.

page.notes: Long s rendered as s; some words in the scan are blurred (e.g. "Camœnæ", "tramite", "fœderato") but read as printed. Verse lines kept as printed, with line breaks marked by br.
